stories.title: China to cut tariffs on Canadian pork and seafood ahead of APEC
stories.summary: China will cut tariffs on roughly C$400 million of Canadian exports including pork and seafood, as Xi Jinping met Prime Minister Mark Carney ahead of the APEC summit. Carney hailed greater predictability and stability in China-Canada relations.

stories.title: Trump says US taking Iran dirty-bomb report seriously
stories.summary: Trump said Tuesday the US is taking seriously the possibility Iran could be planning a so-called dirty-bomb attack in Washington, after a CNN report citing US intelligence. Tehran denied the report.

stories.title: Ukraine damages Crimean bridge in second day of strikes
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones and missiles hit the Kerch bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea for a second straight day, collapsing the road span days before Putin is set to meet Trump and Xi. Zelenskiy called it retaliation for Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure.

stories.title: NSA classified internal network went down, officials say no attack
stories.summary: NSANet, the NSA classified internal communications network, went offline Tuesday during what the agency described as routine maintenance. Officials said there was no indication of a cyberattack and that mission-critical systems remained operational.

stories.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models
stories.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra, a frontier model aimed at professional and scientific work, and GPT-6.2 Sol, a smaller model for everyday tasks. Both deliver better results while using fewer output tokens, lowering cost per task.

stories.title: Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: In his first public statement since resigning, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled he would return as CEO if the board decides it serves the company, as an open letter from more than 10,000 employees and tech figures backed him.

stories.title: Voyage Labs raises $12M for AI travel assistant
stories.summary: Voyage Labs announced a $12 million seed round led by Kleiner Perkins for Atlas, an AI assistant that plans and books entire trips. The funding will expand supplier partnerships and grow its engineering team.

stories.title: Browns-Raiders game flexed to Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: The NFL flexed the Browns Week 12 game against the Las Vegas Raiders on Nov. 29 to Sunday Night Football, giving a 6-4 Cleveland team a rare prime-time spotlight after it rallied past Houston on Sunday.

stories.title: OBR: Browns fans embrace a winning season with guarded optimism
stories.summary: TheOBR daily roundup says Browns fans are enjoying a 6-4 start but staying guarded, noting Todd Monken is one of only seven Browns coaches to open 6-4 or better. It frames the fanbase cautious embrace of a rare winning season.

stories.title: Ryan Day calls Luke Fahey pretty unflappable after first win
stories.summary: Ryan Day praised true freshman QB Luke Fahey as pretty unflappable ahead of the trip to Nebraska on Saturday, backing him as the starter despite fan calls for a change. Fahey won his first game as starter against Northwestern.

stories.title: Jakoobi Jackson still not running, Day says return unclear
stories.summary: Ryan Day said running back Jakoobi Jackson is still week to week and has not started running since foot surgery, making a regular-season return unlikely. Bo Jackson has carried the load in his absence.

stories.title: Day: Buckeyes still hopeful for College Football Playoff berth
stories.summary: Ryan Day said Ohio State remains in the College Football Playoff conversation, citing two road wins over top-15 teams, but acknowledged the Buckeyes need help. He said Jake Cook is definitely in the mix to start on the offensive line at Nebraska.

stories.title: Day locks in Siereveld at left tackle, Moore at right tackle
stories.summary: Ryan Day said Austin Siereveld will stay at left tackle and Ian Moore at right tackle, keeping the line that beat Northwestern. He added Jake Cook will keep playing, not just as the sixth lineman.

stories.title: Hamilton: much still to do on F1 diversity
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton said there is still much work to do on diversity in Formula 1, continuing his push for greater inclusion in a sport he argues remains far from where it should be.

stories.title: BBC looks back at Formula 1 one-race wonders
stories.summary: A BBC Sport feature revisits drivers who raced in Formula 1 just once, exploring what became of those who reached the sport pinnacle for a single grand prix.

stories.title: Tarkov mobile spin-off will be a top-down extraction shooter
stories.summary: Battlestate Games confirmed its upcoming Escape from Tarkov mobile spin-off will use a top-down view rather than first-person, a separate experience set in the same universe. An official reveal could come in 2027.

stories.title: Tarkov Nikita Buyanov: I want everybody to be happy on PvE vs PvP
stories.summary: Battlestate Games studio head Nikita Buyanov said about 60 percent of Tarkov players are on the PvE platform and pushed back on the idea that PvP is dying, saying the studio wants both audiences to be happy.

stories.title: Estrella Tower project gets final Downtown Commission approval
stories.summary: Columbus Business First reports the Downtown Commission gave final approval to the Estrella Tower development, with a rooftop pool and penthouses added to the concept.

stories.title: Columbus Council delays Lufthansa subsidy vote for Frankfurt flight
stories.summary: Columbus City Council voted 9-0 to strip $300,000 earmarked for Lufthansa from a One Columbus funding package, delaying a decision on subsidizing the city first direct flight to Europe. The move extends a dispute with Mayor Ginther over city investment authority.

stories.title: Juvenile injured in single-car crash in northeast Columbus
stories.summary: A juvenile was taken to the hospital after a single-car crash on the northeast side early Tuesday, according to 10TV.
